device_entry.name: 光纤振动器
tags: 显微成像与光学显微实验
device_entry.description: 光纤振动器是一种用于机械振动光纤的实验装置，常用于激光照明路径中，通过持续扰动光纤来降低散斑并改善照明均匀性，适合显微成像等光学实验。
device_entry.description_en: A fiber shaker is a laboratory device that mechanically vibrates an optical fiber. It is commonly used in laser illumination paths to reduce speckle and improve illumination uniformity, especially in microscopy and other optical experiments.
